ReportedError: Missing Handled property while typing reviewer name
Cause: WPF event parameter args collided with the automatic PowerShell args variable. The keyboard handler lost the event, and the dispatcher handler masked the original error with a second event-argument failure.
LauncherCause: UTF-8 BOM before @echo off was interpreted as command characters by CMD.
LauncherCorrection: ASCII, no BOM, existing CRLF preserved.
Fixtures: Synthetic event object and synthetic original error only. No screenshot content, reviewer identity or clinical document was copied into the repository.
